primitives.name: Spatial Distance Tracker
primitives.verbatim_quote: The Linesman, under supervision of the Referee, shall mark the distances gained or lost in the progress of the play.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'d': 'distance in yards', 't': 'time in seconds', 'p': 'position vector in yards'}
primitives.assumptions: Play progression is linear; distance measured per down; referee authority ensures accuracy.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When ball crosses boundary or play halts.

layer2.mapping: Tracks net displacement vector p(t) = p₀ + ∫v(t)dt using rod-based measurements.
layer2.telemetry: Ball position recorded at each down via iron rod.

primitives.name: Boundary Position Marker
primitives.verbatim_quote: The Linesman shall mark the point where the ball goes out of bounds on the side of the field occupied by him.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'b': 'boundary crossing event', 'x_b': 'x-coordinate of boundary point in yards'}
primitives.assumptions: Field is bounded; boundary defined by sideline; single side-line reference used.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Upon ball exit from field of play.

layer2.mapping: Isomorphic to a discrete event detection system where x_b = f(ball trajectory, sideline equation).
layer2.telemetry: Iron rod marks exact x_b upon out-of-bounds event.

primitives.name: Assistant Rod Measurer
primitives.verbatim_quote: These assistants, in the measuring of distances, shall use two rods about 6 feet in length and connected at their lower ends by a stout cord or chain 10 yards in length.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'L': 'rod length = 6 ft', 'C': 'chain length = 10 yd', 'm': 'measured distance in yards'}
primitives.assumptions: Rods form fixed geometric constraints; chain provides tension for accurate measurement.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When precise yardage must be determined within 10-yard span.

layer2.mapping: Measures m = C × sin(θ), where θ is angle between rods and vertical axis.
layer2.telemetry: Chain and rod configuration yields m via trigonometric projection.
